question: Gangubai Hangal was an Indian singer of the Khayal genre of Hindustani classical music from _______, who was known for her deep and powerful voice.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gangubai Hangal** was an Indian singer of **the Khayal genre of Hindustani classical music.**
 
• She was born in Dharwad, Karnataka in 1913.
